title: 2021 Prairie, the High house, rises to its steep gable and turret
items: 2021 Prairie, James L. High's house, now stands as its one old photograph shows it: dark brick under a steep slate front gable with three attic windows, a round turret at the north corner whose slate cone rises from the roofline over a round-headed door, a tall chimney on the south side, and a broad wing standing out to the south under a gable of its own. Its porch, the stoop that climbs along the front and the turret's finial are still simpler than the picture; the next pass on this block takes those on.
